patterns.name: Narrative Report
patterns.description: Written findings with the conventional report sections.

patterns.name: Referral Laboratory Report
patterns.description: Performed elsewhere. The referral laboratory's own report is the record; these fields are optional metadata alongside the attached document.

patterns.name: Direct Detection / Microscopy
patterns.description: Organism or parasite sought directly by microscopy or stain.

patterns.name: Molecular Detection (PCR / NAAT)
patterns.description: Nucleic acid amplification. Qualitative detection, with an optional quantitative result where the assay reports one.

patterns.name: Culture and Susceptibility
patterns.description: Bacterial or fungal culture with organism identification and susceptibility reporting.

patterns.name: Infectious Serology
patterns.description: Antibody or antigen serology for an infectious agent.

patterns.name: Autoantibody
patterns.description: Autoantibody testing, commonly reported as a qualitative result with a level, titre or staining pattern.

patterns.name: Cell Marker Panel
patterns.description: Flow cytometry or cell-subset panel reported as marker values.

patterns.name: Single Result, Units Unconfirmed
patterns.description: A single result field for a test whose units this library could not confirm. The activating clinic supplies the units.

patterns.name: Infection Result, Shape Unconfirmed
patterns.description: A microbiology or virology result whose reporting shape this library could not confirm. The activating clinic defines the fields.
